On reuse it reads symbol/import rows back out of the store and only refreshes `mtime`/`tokens`; otherwise it re-extracts symbols and imports, rewrites the file row and page, and returns `reused: false`. `indexFiles`/`indexCorpus` aggregate these `reused` flags into the counters exposed by the MCP hook and watch log lines.
